description: A wire basket sits on the table with a shiny metal tray inside holding several colorful plastic utensils, and there’s open space to the right where utensils can be laid out. The right hand reaches forward into the tray, gathers a small bundle of utensils as a right-hand object, lifts them up and moves them to the right side of the table, then releases them one by one into a neat row; the left hand stays low and mostly still nearby without touching anything.
